entries.title: A closed task's temporary files go even when they hold a desktop app's files
entries.body: A temporary folder holding an installed desktop app, or a project's copy of one, stayed on your disk after its task closed, and the task's record said a volume was still mounted. Those folders now go when the task closes, and the week-later cleanup of a task's other leftover files no longer stops at them, on this computer and on a computer that runs your work.
entries.noPicture: The fix frees disk space in the background; the task's record shows the same line it shows for any removed temporary folder.
